name: workflow: find one, read its inputs, run it, report the result
description: The end-to-end shape a GTN tutorial has, reduced to something that finishes in a minute: the agent must locate a stored workflow by subject, read what it asks for, map the history's dataset onto that input, invoke it, wait, and say what came out. The fixture runs Cut1, a core tool present on every server, so a failure is the agent or the plumbing rather than a missing dependency. Its name, annotation and behaviour agree deliberately: the first draft paired a workflow called 'Read quality control and trimming' with a CSV, and the agent refused it as scientifically wrong, which was the agent being right and the scenario being incoherent. Graded against Galaxy's invocation record, not the agent's narration -- a launch that never scheduled reads identically in chat to one that ran.
inputs: I have one tabular dataset in this history. Find the saved workflow that filters table rows by value, run it on that dataset, and once it has finished tell me what it produced.
